stemMarkdown: The average weight of 10 students increases by 3 kg when a new student replaces one weighing 58 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new student?
solutionMarkdown: The total weight rises by $10 \times 3 = 30$ kg. That entire increase comes from one swap, so the new student is $30$ kg heavier than the one who left: $58 + 30 = 88$ kg.
